verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no bulk data export or account-exit feature, such as a full export archive, CSV or JSON dump, or offboarding export. What it does show is read API endpoints (jobs, candidates, offers as JSON) and a generic claim of 'full control over your data'. Those are developer building blocks a user would have to script into an export, so they do not earn credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
